a: USD $1,000 and framed certificate; up to USD $1,000 toward travel to the ECS fall meeting
dt: Nomination period Oct 15 - Jan 15, annually; this cycle closes Jan 15, 2027; presented at the ECS fall meeting
e: Recognizes outstanding MS or PhD research in corrosion science or engineering by people who completed their graduate degree within two years before the nomination deadline. Nomination package includes a nomination letter, a 2-3 page research summary and the academic record; no citizenship limits stated.
n: ECS Corrosion Division Morris Cohen Graduate Student Award
unv: The page gives the annual Oct 15 - Jan 15 window; the 2027 closing date is taken from that annual window.
